sha_fields.approved_against_commit_sha: The full code-baseline SHA used for A approval; it must be an ancestor of later implementation/run commits and is not required to equal their HEAD.
sha_fields.implementation_commit_sha: The full SHA of C/D implementation being proposed or reviewed; optional when a proposal has no code implementation.
sha_fields.commit_sha: The full clean HEAD that actually produced run, prediction, checkpoint, metric, or final-approval evidence.

decision: Use experiment_id as the sole experiment identifier and the contract-type SHA field above. baseline_experiment_id refers to an experiment, never a Git revision.
